lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is variable, with higher density in the central torso region and wider gaps toward the posterior and anterior sections.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most posterior vertical line is a shortened segment. The two most anterior lines near the base of the neck terminate before reaching the lower ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct circular white spots are visible on the lower posterior haunch, located in a low-density cluster above the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The three visible spots on the posterior haunch are aligned in a rough horizontal geometric row.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking on the bridge of the muzzle. Distinct white horizontal band on the lower neck/throat. Single white spots visible on the inner surface of the lower limbs.
